name: motion-loading-progress-bar
description: Marketing loading capsule whose fill springs toward discrete progress jumps, still when motion is reduced.
purpose: Shows a waiting or sync beat on a landing page as a spring-smoothed bar instead of a spinner or a stepped width snap.
bestFor: onboarding progress on a marketing page
avoidFor: task consoles that need a native progress control
pages that cannot show indeterminate looping motion
